en.bodyHtml:
Bet Sizing Basics in Poker

Author: Roman Shaposhnikov

Date: 12.01.2026

Bet sizing is one of the most critical elements of poker. The size of your bet determines whether you can win the maximum when ahead and lose the minimum when behind. Let us look at how to choose the right bet size and avoid typical beginner mistakes.

What Is Bet Sizing?

Bet sizing is the size of your bet depending on the situation. It defines the pot odds you give your opponent and how profitable it is for them to continue.

You win money over the long run from every mistake your opponent makes. A well-chosen bet size increases your profit.

💪 Why Bet Bigger?

In most situations aggressive sizing is the optimal choice:

• You do not give opponents good odds to call with draws
• You get more value when worse hands call
• A bet below half the pot almost always means missed value and weak protection

If you regularly make small bets, you effectively let opponents see the next card cheaply. Larger bets protect your hand and punish mistakes.

When Are Small Bets Appropriate?

Small bets (for example 1/3 or 1/4 pot) can be justified in specific spots:

• Against nits: when you are sure they fold to a large bet but call a small one for thin value
• On dry boards: when the texture minimizes obvious draw hands

These spots require accurate reads. Without precise information, it is always better to bet more rather than less.

Preflop Bet Sizing

Basic rule for an opening raise (Open Raise): 👉 Raise = 3 BB + 1 BB for each limper already in the pot.

For example, with two limpers your raise should be 5 BB. This protects you from multi-way pots and makes opponents pay more to see the flop.

LimpersRaise size (BB)Example NL10
03 BB$0.30
14 BB$0.40
25 BB$0.50
36 BB$0.60
47 BB$0.70
58 BB$0.80

Summary

To play profitably, follow three simple rules:

1. Postflop, bet bigger — usually around ¾ pot
2. Preflop, raise 3–4 BB + 1 BB per limper
3. Do not give opponents cheap cards — always aim to maximize value and protect your hand

Small sizes lead to missed profit. Smart sizing leads to control and long-term success.

uz.bodyHtml:
Pokerda bet sizing asoslari

Muallif: Roman Shaposhnikov

Sana: 12.01.2026

Bet sizing pokerning eng muhim elementlaridan biridir. Stavka hajmi oldinda bo'lganda maksimum yutish va orqada bo'lganda minimum yo'qotish imkonini belgilaydi.

Bet sizing nima?

Bet sizing — vaziyatga qarab stavka hajmi. U raqibga qanday pot odds berishingizni va unga davom etish qanchalik foydali ekanini belgilaydi.

Raqibning har bir xatosidan uzoq muddatda pul yutasiz. To'g'ri hajm foydingizni oshiradi.

💪 Nega kattaroq stavka qilish kerak?

Ko'p hollarda agressiv sizing optimal:

• Raqibga dro bilan call uchun yaxshi odds bermaysiz
• Yomon qo'llar call qilganda ko'proq value olasiz
• Bankning yarmidan kichik stavka deyarli har doim o'tkazib yuborilgan value va zaif himoya

Qachon kichik stavkalar mos?

• Nitlarga qarshi: katta stavkada fold, kichikda call — thin value
• Quruq boardlarda: aniq dro kam

Preflop bet sizing

Open Raise qoidasi: 👉 Reyз = 3 BB + har bir limper uchun 1 BB.

LimperlarReyз (BB)NL10 misol
03 BB$0.30
14 BB$0.40
25 BB$0.50
36 BB$0.60
47 BB$0.70
58 BB$0.80

Xulosa

1. Postflop — taxminan ¾ bank
2. Preflop — 3–4 BB + 1 BB limper uchun
3. Raqiblarga arzon kartalar bermang

kz.description: Пokerде bet sizing негіздері: неге үлкен ставкalar qolды qorğaydy, preflop open-raise (3 BB + limperler) және postflop value. PPPoker NUTS klubında жаттығыңыз.
kz.bodyHtml:
Пokerде bet sizing негіздері

Автор: Роман Шапошников

Күні: 12.01.2026

Bet sizing — покердің ең маңызды элементтерінің бірі. Ставка мөлшері алда болғанда максимум ұтып, артта болғанда минимум жоғалту мүмкіндігін анықтайды.

Bet sizing деген не?

Bet sizing — жағдайға байланысты ставка мөлшері. Ол қарсыласқа pot odds қалай беретininizi анықтайды.

Қарсылас әр қатесінен ұзақ мерзімде ақша ұтып alасыз. Дұрыс мөлшер пайdaңызды арттырады.

💪 Неге үлкенірек ставка?

• Dro-пен call үшін жақсы odds бермейсіз
• Нашар қолдар call etkende ko'proq value
• Banktin jartysy nan kishi stavka — o'tkazilgan value

Preflop bet sizing

Open Raise: 👉 Reyз = 3 BB + әр limper үшін 1 BB.

LimperlerReyз (BB)NL10 мысал
03 BB$0.30
14 BB$0.40
25 BB$0.50

Qorytyndy

Postflop — ¾ bank; preflop — 3–4 BB + 1 BB limper үшін.

♠️ Bet sizing-ті практикада тексеріңіз! PPPoker NUTS klubında oynap, strategiyany jetildiring.

Bet sizing — яке az muҳimtarin unsurhoi poker. Andозаи ставка муайян мекунад, ки дар пesh qand yutuq va pas kamtar бохт медиҳед.

Bet sizing чист?

Bet sizing — андозаи ставка дар вазият. Pot odds-ро ба рақиб медиҳад.

💪 Чаро бештар?

• Draw бо call — odds-и бад
• Value зиёдтар
• Стavkaи хурд — value-и аз даст рафта

Open Raise: 3 BB + 1 BB барои har limper.
